Updated unknown reason fallback in strategyMetricsReasonText to return { text: code, code } instead of t('strategy.metricsReason.other') ('Not recorded' / '未記錄').

AC4_lineage_enter_before_candidates_load.implementation: Added candidatesLoading and pendingNameLookup state to LineageExplorerPage in src/management/pages/phase2/LineageExplorer.tsx. While candidates are loading, a visible status line (data-testid='lineage-candidates-loading', lineageExplorer.loadingCandidates) is shown. Pressing Enter while candidates are loading queues non-ID text in pendingNameLookup and never sends it as activeRootId; once candidates resolve, pendingNameLookup resolves the matching candidate ID and commits it (and non-ID text that still does not match any candidate is never committed as root).
tests: src/management/pages/phase2/LineageExplorer.test.tsx > Pressing Enter before the candidate name list has loaded shows a loading line, never sends non-ID text as root while loading, and resolves the name once loaded (FE-REGISTRY-ACCEPTANCE-WORDS-20261126 AC4)
